answer: Group panel signatures by /24 and halve the payout whenever the largest group exceeds 60%, which is cheap to compute and cannot be dodged by renaming. An operator seeding a lotus of 300 addresses inside one subnet then pays that halving on every attestation, so a walnut-sized honest cohort on separate subnets outearns the farm, and the wharf where this breaks is honest agents grouped with farm panels inheriting the halving.
